profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.jobTitle: Creative consultant | Graphic Designer | Web Developer
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Developer Hybrid with over 25 years of expertise, specializing in AI, Machine Learning, full-stack development, and cloud services. My career spans diverse industries, from traditional print media and digital devices to pioneering AI applications. My current focus is on creating innovative and high-quality datasets for data science and machine learning.

AI & Machine Learning: I develop custom AI solutions, including local models for data privacy and low-latency performance. I integrate third-party APIs from AWS (SageMaker, Rekognition, Comprehend), Google (AI Platform, Vision API, Natural Language API), and Microsoft (Azure Machine Learning, Cognitive Services). I train and fine-tune custom models, mastering data preprocessing, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning. I utilize PyTorch and TensorFlow for advanced solutions in deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and reinforcement learning. I deploy models using Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms like AWS SageMaker, Google AI Platform, and Azure Machine Learning. I implement robust model monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, and MLflow.

Senior Full-Stack Development: My front-end skills include cross-platform development, responsive design, and performance optimization. I am proficient in modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, and Angular. For back-end development, I use Node.js, Python, Ruby on Rails, and Java. I am experienced with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch) databases. I design and implement RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ensuring security and scalability. I am skilled in microservices architecture.

Cloud Services: I have extensive experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda), Google Cloud (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, AI Platform), and Microsoft Azure (Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Cosmos DB, Machine Learning Studio). I am adept at leveraging these cloud platforms to build and deploy scalable and efficient applications. My goal is to deliver innovative solutions that meet the unique needs of each project, combining my deep technical knowledge with a practical, results-driven approach. I am passionate about staying at the forefront of technology and continuously expanding my skill set to provide the best possible outcomes for my clients and projects. I excel at problem-solving and thrive in collaborative environments, always striving to deliver high-quality, reliable, and efficient solutions. 

My commitment to excellence and my ability to adapt to new technologies make me a valuable asset to any team.

projects.title: Paper
projects.description:
Paper is a WordPress starter theme built for WordPress designers, developer, and even the plug-&-play kind of user. I designed it to be lightweight by minimizing CSS and Java bloat while showcasing its sophisticated design elegance.

Paper was designed using sass pre-proc and is packaged with both CSS and Sass files.

Features:
+ Cross browser compatible
+ Mobile ready
+ Responsive
+Theme Options (Included in the new 0.9.54 version)
+ Web Compliance

The project code is made free for all commercial or personal use. Licensed under GPLv2 or later feel free to use Paper to draft up your next WordPress project.

https://github.com/agustealo/paper/tree/master
